content:
Quick answer

For a company team, corporate event or brand activation, MOMUTO makes custom kits with your brand colours and logo, in polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

Your brand on the pitch

A company five-a-side, a client tournament, a trade-show activation — a branded kit turns a group into a team and puts your logo on every photo. Start from the free 3D configurator, or hand a designer your brand guidelines.

Exact brand colours, printed in

Sublimation reproduces precise brand colours and logos edge to edge, with no peeling after a few washes. Bring your hex codes and logo — see the colour guide and printing & materials.

From five players to a whole department

No minimum order and sizes from kids’ XS to adult 4XL, so you can kit a five-a-side or a whole department in one go. Size guide.

Frequently asked questions

Can you match our exact brand colours?

Yes. Sublimation reproduces precise brand colours from your hex codes and prints your logo into the fabric, edge to edge.

Is there a minimum for a company team?

No minimum order — from five players to a whole department, in any mix of sizes.

Can we get them in time for an event?

Allow 25–30 days from order to delivery. For a fixed event date, order at least five weeks ahead.
